key_reasoning.reason: Introduces a brand-new shared contract (PlanKind/PlannedAction in src/types/dry-run.ts) consumed by agents, providers, frameworks and the CLI, plus new required describe* seams (describeInstall/describeUninstall/describeAdditionalInstallation/describeCredentialSideEffects) on every adapter hierarchy and a tiered dry-run registration abstraction. Touches 20+ plugin implementations across three subsystems and the bin entry point.

Safety-critical feature: the dry-run promise of 'nothing changes' must hold across every mutating command. Each describe* method must be pure (no write, no network, no credential-store write, no spawned process); no prior template covers this side-effect-free description pattern. New defensive logic (raw-argv predicate distinguishing --dry-run=false/--no-dry-run/-- delimiter/--task value, once-only end-cap with exit fallback). Security-sensitive due to credential side-effect descriptions and the proxy-must-stop path in BaseAgentAdapter.run().

67 files changed, 3790 insertions(+), 240 deletions(-) spanning bin/, src/cli, src/agents, src/providers, src/frameworks, and a new src/types module. Several new files (dry-run model, shared dry-run core, registration table) plus new test suites.

Touches UI (CLI rendering: printPlannedActions/footers/end-cap), API (commander command definitions and the dry-run registration table), Service (adapter/plugin describe logic and provider setup-step descriptions), Infrastructure (startup side-effect gating in src/cli/startup.ts and bin/codemie.js, proxy connect/disconnect orchestrators and connectors), with external-integration touchpoints (VS Code, Claude/Codex desktop, provider connectors) — a cross-cutting concern added across several layers.

red_flags_applied: Technical Risk bumped L→XL: security/safety-sensitive dry-run guarantee that describe seams never mutate the machine, reach the network, or write credentials

Component Scope capped at XXL: touches core shared abstractions (BaseAgentAdapter, BaseFrameworkAdapter, agent/framework/provider core types) and affects multiple CLI workflows plus all agent/provider/framework plugins
split_recommendation: by-component + by-dependency: (1) shared dry-run model (src/types/dry-run.ts) and describe* seams on the three adapter cores first, (2) per-hierarchy describe* implementations (agents → providers → frameworks), (3) CLI registration table and per-command preview wiring. Foundation-first; no slice spans the agents/providers/frameworks/CLI subsystems.
